text: {"lessons":["My account rose early, then fell for several months before recovering; short-term swings are uncomfortable, but they do not reliably predict what comes next.","I made no trades, so I avoided impulsive decisions; I should keep using a deliberate plan rather than reacting to daily price moves.","Because losses weigh on me more than gains please me, I should set clear risk limits and make decisions based on my goals, not fear or reluctance to admit a mistake."]}
